messages:
ellie: FYI forwarding customer report — ACME Prod hitting p95/p99 spikes + intermittent 502/504s since ~02:15 UTC. Customer says responses sometimes take 2–3s. They included a few log snippets that mention OOM-related slowdowns and 'alloc retry' traces.

max: taking this. can you share tenant id, model, and region?
ellie: tenant=acme-prod, model=redwood/llama-3b-quant@v1.2, region=us-west-2. p95 jumped from ~150ms -> ~420ms in last 3h; p99 from ~880ms -> ~2.6s. No config changes on their side.

liwei: pulling infra metrics now.
ops-bot: [alert] gpu-node-7: gpu_mem_util=98%, slab_frag=0.61, kv_size=1.9GB -> 3.8GB (2h). OOM events: 4 warnings in last hour.

max: KV growth + high slab fragmentation — classic memory pressure. Do they have very long-lived sessions / large contexts?
ellie: yes, streaming chat with multi-turn history; they reported sessions >20k tokens.

max: quick repro curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood/llama-3b-quant@v1.2","input":"<long running chat with 20k tokens>"}'
```

max: mitigation options (short-term):
- enable per-tenant fallback routing to cpu-small for new requests (reduces GPU pressure)
- set tenant kv_eviction_policy=aggressive (evict older convo state)
- trigger slab compaction on hot nodes: REDWOOD_SLAB_COMPACT=1
- temporarily cap max_context_length for acme-prod to 8k tokens

liwei: I'll run a targeted compaction + forced evict of keys older than 1h for acme-prod. Command: `rbctl node compact --node gpu-7 --mode aggressive` (ETA 3–5m).
ops-bot: [action] compact started on gpu-7 by liwei at 02:48 UTC.

max: also recommend canary allocator tuning: set MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 and deploy canary image to 5% of ai-runtime pods — should drop fragmentation. We'll patch image and push canary.
tara: added a sampling alert for long-kv hits (trigger if avg keys_per_conn > 1.5k over 15m). Also adding a dashboard tile for slab_frag per node.

liwei: compaction finished. Observed immediate mem_util drop: 98% -> 72%. KV size trimmed 3.8GB -> 2.1GB. p95 improved to ~200–350ms, p99 to ~900ms. No new OOMs in 12m post-compaction.
ellie: relayed temporary fallback + context cap to customer; they accepted fallback to cpu for new sessions while we stabilize. :thumbsup:

max: follow-ups (action items):
1) Roll out allocator tuning (MALLOC_ARENA_MAX) to runtime canary + monitor slab_frag/tail latency at 10/30/60m windows.
2) Add tenant-level default kv TTL (e.g., 1h) and opt-out for customers needing long history.
3) Add automatic aggressive eviction policy when slab_frag > 0.55 and kv_growth_rate > 30% over 15m.
4) Postmortem if recurrence within 7 days.

ellie: created support ticket #12345 and informed customer of fixes and plan. Closing on our side unless they reopen.

max: thanks everyone, good triage. :raised_hands:
